response.sql: WITH equipment_humidity AS (SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipment_reference, AVG(se.humepct) AS average_humidity FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry GROUP BY e.equipregistry), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS all_equipment_average FROM equipment_humidity), above_average AS (SELECT eh.equipment_reference, eh.average_humidity, o.all_equipment_average FROM equipment_humidity eh CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE eh.average_humidity > o.all_equipment_average), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS above_average_group_mean FROM above_average) SELECT a.equipment_reference, a.average_humidity, a.average_humidity - a.all_equipment_average AS exceeds_all_equipment_average, a.average_humidity - g.above_average_group_mean AS difference_from_group_mean FROM above_average a CROSS JOIN group_average g WHERE a.all_equipment_average IS NOT NULL AND g.above_average_group_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
